newsitem.title: FRANCE: Michelin to redeem bonds, stock falls.
newsitem.headline: Michelin to redeem bonds, stock falls.

text.p: Michelin was the biggest loser in the Paris bourse's CAC 40 on Friday after announcing in a financial advertisement that it would issue shares to redeem 1.5 billion francs of convertible bonds due in 1998.
The stock was down 2.5 percent at 249.50 francs at 0910 GMT, while the bourse index was up 0.7 percent. Traders said the share's fall was due to the dilutive effect of the redemption.

"As at 14 October, 1996, the conversion rate was 44.79 B shares for each 10,000 francs principal amount of bonds, the latest price of a B share was 258.60 francs and the aggregate principal amount of the bonds outstanding was 1,441,170,000 francs," Michelin said.
It said it would redeem the bonds on November 18 at 10,300 francs plus 526.67 francs of accrued interest per 10,000 francs of principal amount of bonds.
